name: Dream of the Hikikomori
source:
As you and your weeaboo friends are having a great time hanging out at the anime club suddenly, everything changes for the worst.

While preparing to play a parody visual novel game your friend recommended, appearing onscreen you all spot a mysterious link.

What the barnacle is this?! Let's see what it says...

Waifu simulator, download now.

Suddenly, your friend Akira reaches over and hits download.

"No! Stop!" you scream, but it's too late.

From that day forth, you and your group of friends are trapped inside a dating simulator, as the romanceable waifus. Will you escape and make it back to the real world? Or will the protagonist get to you first?

Visual novel games and dating simulators have been part of otaku culture since long ago. Don't you think it's time to see things from the perspective of the waifu?

[From [url=https://sean12263.itch.io/dream-of-the-hikikimori]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你和你的weeaboo朋友在动漫俱乐部玩得很开心时，突然一切都发生了最坏的情况。

当准备玩朋友推荐的模仿视觉小说游戏时，出现在屏幕上的你们都发现了一个神秘的链接。

这是什么藤壶？！让我们看看它说了什么…

Waifu模拟器，立即下载。

突然，你的朋友Akira伸手点击下载。

“不！停下来！”你尖叫，但已经太晚了。

从那天起，你和你的一群朋友就被困在约会模拟器中，成为浪漫的流浪汉。你会逃脱并回到现实世界吗？还是主角会先找到你？

视觉小说游戏和约会模拟器很久以前就已经成为御宅族文化的一部分。你不觉得是时候从外夫的角度看问题了吗？

[来自[url=https://sean12263.itch.io/dream-of-the-hikikimori]Itch.io[/url]]
